svg.title: One HTTPS request is five round trips, and four are setup
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One HTTPS request is five round trips, and four are setup” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A millisecond timeline of one HTTPS request drawn to scale: DNS to 6.9 ms, TCP handshake to 17.4, TLS to 32.3, server thinking to 45.2, and 221 KB of body arriving by 71.8 ms. A second row crosses out the three setup phases in red, and a third row shows the same request on a reused connection finishing in 39.5 ms. Bars below compare six fresh connections at 780 ms with six over one connection at 204 ms.
